questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) is known to everyone that smoking is bad.
questions.explanation: It は形式主語。本当の主語は that 以下。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: The reason he was absent is (   ) he was sick.
questions.explanation: The reason is that 〜 で「理由は〜ということだ」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: No matter (   ) hard it is, I'll finish it.
questions.explanation: no matter how + 形容詞 で「どんなに〜でも」（= however）。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Whether you like it (   ) not, you must go.
questions.explanation: whether A or not で「A であろうとなかろうと」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: It is not what you say (   ) what you do that matters.
questions.explanation: It is not A but B that … で「…なのは A ではなく B だ」（強調構文）。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This is the same watch (   ) I lost.
questions.explanation: the same 〜 as … で「…と同じ（種類の）〜」。
